MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 33
   C. 27.7
   D. 27.6

2. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 12
   C. 36
   D. 42

3. Solve for x: x + 5 = 12. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 7
   C. 8
   D. 12

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 2
   C. 10
   D. 14

5. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 11
   C. 5
   D. 24

6. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 25
   C. 2
   D. 1

7. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/4
   D. They are equal

8. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 37

9. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 24
   C. 48
   D. 144

10. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 28
   C. 22
   D. 33

11. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 2
   C. 24
   D. 10

12. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 8
   C. 0
   D. 16

13. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 45
   D. 30

14. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x
   D. 12x + 2

15. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 41
   C. 40
   D. 13

16. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 18
   C. 90
   D. 81

17. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 25
   C. 26
   D. 5

18. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 36
   C. 37
   D. 5

19. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 1/4
   C. 3/4
   D. 1/2

20. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31
   C. 31.7
   D. 37

21. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 0
   C. 65
   D. 16

22. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 0.205
   C. 0.025
   D. 2.5

23. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

24. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 4
   C. 8
   D. 5

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
